say:0:1610519001:0.text: We moved here from Savannah so I could attend the Serene Lyceum.
say:0:1610519001:0.source_cn: 我们一家本来住在赛凡纳，爸爸妈妈是为了我的学业才搬来这里的。
say:0:1610519001:0.male: We moved here from Savannah so I could attend the Serene Lyceum.
say:0:1610519001:0.female: We moved here from Savannah so I could attend the Serene Lyceum.

say:1:1610519002:0.text: It's a bit out of the way, but the land's cheap, and close to the Lyceum.
say:1:1610519002:0.source_cn: 虽然偏僻了点，但是地价便宜，离学校也不远。
say:1:1610519002:0.male: It's a bit out of the way, but the land's cheap, and close to the Lyceum.
say:1:1610519002:0.female: It's a bit out of the way, but the land's cheap, and close to the Lyceum.
